layouts.name: Achna main course
layouts.description: The operator's published course plan identifies the closed main circuit with the northern and southern hairpins and western return. Exact independent source way 734690065 indices 5 through 64 retain its closed paved course, excluding the straight's southern extension. Public satellite imagery independently confirms these physical course branches. Fine corner alignment and direction remain draft.

layouts.name: Achna inner alternative
layouts.description: The operator course plan identifies the inner hairpin alternative connecting the northern cross-course section to the western return. Exact independent source way 734690066 preserves both real mapped junction endpoints. This connecting branch is not a separately timed lap.

layouts.name: Achna full straight
layouts.description: The operator course plan shows the long cross-course straight continuing beyond the closed circuit. Independent source way 734690065 indices 0 through 6 retain the real southern open end and northern hairpin junction. This physical straight is a component of the full-straight configuration, not an invented closed lap or a surveyed timed drag distance.

Retain these exact independent source paths as the selectable configuration set, excluding the straight's southern extension.
